responsibility: Provides the documentation URL mapping for the Xstormy16 target option table declared in stormy16.opt. This autogenerated companion file associates the backend’s msim switch with its anchor in the generated GCC manual so option metadata can link diagnostics/help output to the correct Xstormy16 options documentation page; it carries no code-generation logic itself, only option-to-manual reference data consumed by GCC’s option documentation infrastructure.
